text:
### Impersonation
**What It Is:** Fraudster pretends to be customer or FirstUK staff
**Signs:** Customer claims "I didn't authorize this"
**Prevention:** Verify identity, document authorization
name: Chunk 35/61

raw_entities.name: Fraudster Impersonation of Customer or Staff
raw_entities.description: A fraud scenario where a fraudster pretends to be either the customer or FirstUK staff member. This is identified when a customer claims they did not authorize a transaction or action. Staff must verify identity and document all authorization to prevent this type of fraud.
context: Fraudster pretends to be customer or FirstUK staff

raw_entities.name: Identity Verification and Authorization Documentation
raw_entities.description: Staff must verify the identity of parties involved in transactions and document all authorizations to prevent impersonation fraud. This is a mandatory control when a customer disputes a transaction or authorization.
